Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 炭灰宽松短袖V领T恤，前胸交叉细绳与暗色横条图案，内搭黑色细吊带；浅蓝水洗补丁直筒牛仔裤束入黑色尖头中筒细跟靴，靴面斜带和银链属于鞋的固定装饰。。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue product photo. Pure white seamless background, neutral soft studio lighting, realistic fabric texture. Portrait 2:3, full objects uncropped with comfortable margins. NO people, skin, body parts, face, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, stand, scene, text, brand logos or watermark. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation; see white background through sheer fabrics. Preserve the reference garment colors, silhouette, construction and fabric. Do not invent footwear when not visible. Reconstruct obscured seams conservatively. Reference image is design input only. Target ONLY image 1 position single. rNcM means row N, column M, counted left to right, top to bottom across the full image. Images 2 through 8 each have two rows and four columns. Target ONLY the largest central person inside the selected cell; ignore all small background thumbnails. Image 1 is one street-style outfit. All shoes must be EMPTY without feet or toes. All open garment gaps show pure white with no anatomy. Ignore all other outfits, text and objects. GARMENTS AND SHOWN FOOTWEAR ONLY: 炭灰宽松短袖V领T恤，前胸交叉细绳与暗色横条图案，内搭黑色细吊带；浅蓝水洗补丁直筒牛仔裤束入黑色尖头中筒细跟靴，靴面斜带和银链属于鞋的固定装饰。. Remove ALL detachable accessories including 红色铆钉窄颈圈银扣；砖红柔软双肩背包长肩带；黑色手机与深色纹理手机壳；透明塑料饮料杯透明盖黑吸管浅黄茶饮；黑色细手链与红色腕绳组合. Keep integral garment fasteners, sewn bows and ties. No new items.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
